There are three possible sites (A, B, and C), and each has its own pros and cons. All team members must agree on the safest and most viable option for the next six months. Only one site is actually safe post-earthquake. After the choice is made, the team will begin work immediately and cannot switch locations. Collaboration is crucial; only by sharing all unique information can you successfully identify the correct site.
